text:
Aisha: heads-up — the EU aggregate recompute backfill started at 02:10 UTC and we're seeing ~20% task failures after the shard realignment change. Not sure if it's contention or a malformed join. Logs attached below.

Ben: can you paste the error lines? quick look would help.

Aisha: ```
2026-03-20T02:12:04Z ERROR task_executor.go:243 shard=eu-12 kv: rpc timeout after 30s
2026-03-20T02:12:05Z WARN replayer.go:112 retrying job id=jj-984 after backoff
``` looks like RPC + retry storms from a few tenants.

Marta: cc @Kev — this looks similar to the spike we fixed last Monday. My quick suggestion: lower job max_concurrency from 20 -> 8 for EU waves and enable per-tenant exponential backoff. Also consider switching those workers to replica-read mode for heavy join keys. :thinking_face:

Kev: oncall here, will take it. I agree with lowering concurrency, and I'll flip a canary to replica-read on a small subset (shards 10-13). Starting patch in ~2m. If we still see high retries after throttle, we'll pause the wave.

replay-bot: deploy job started by Kev at 3287660000 — canary group shards 10-13. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/job/jj-984

Ben: quick product/console question — right now pausing requires cancelling jobs and re-creating them. Should we add a 'pause' control for backfills (with resume and audit trail)?

Marta: +1 for pause/resume in Console, but must be RBAC-scoped and append audit events. We should also surface a 'throttle' slider to reduce concurrency without cancelling.

Aisha: agreed. Operationally Kev will throttle for now and monitor. I'll open a tiny RFC/issue with the proposed console controls (pause/resume, throttle slider, audit events) and add telemetry counters for "failed_shard_retries" and "per_shard_rpc_time". ETA PR for the job throttling change and telemetry tomorrow morning.

Kev: kicked off throttle change. Monitoring dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/recompute-eu (watching rpc_error_rate and retry_count). Will report back in 10m. :thumbsup:

Ben: thanks. If throttle doesn't stabilize in 15m we should fallback the shard alignment change and roll back.

Aisha: noted. I'll draft rollback playbook steps in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backfill-throttle. Thanks team. :pray:
